mentions.name: Vestiges
mentions.description: A single-player 2D roguelite strategy game with meta progression, some narrative, and a card minigame inspired by the author's work on Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II. Set in the near future, players use the in-game software to navigate a person's digitized mind and read their memories. It is being built with genAI coding tools (Claude Code), its non-text visuals are drawn at runtime with Godot's 2D vector capabilities rather than genAI art, and a playable demo is planned within about a month.
